text_overrides.ordinary_2: Can't complain. There's always meat to prepare.
text_overrides.ordinary_3: Doing well enough. How kind of you to ask.
text_overrides.content_2: Feeling good. Cooking's the part of the job I like best.
text_overrides.content_3: Well enough. Nice to stop for a chat.
text_overrides.stressed_1: A bit tired of it all, honestly.
text_overrides.stressed_2: I've more on my mind than I'd like.
text_overrides.stressed_3: Stretched thin. Could do with a breather.
